title: Nash Incentive-compatible Online Mechanism Learning via Weakly Differentially Private Online Learning
abstract: arXiv:2407.04898v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study a multi-round mechanism design problem, where we interact with a set of agents over a sequence of rounds. We wish to design an incentive-compatible (IC) online learning scheme to maximize an application-specific objective within a given class of mechanisms, without prior knowledge of the agents' type distributions. Even if each mechanism in this class is IC in a single round, if an algorithm naively chooses from this class on each round, the entire learning process may not be IC against non-myopic buyers who appear over multiple rounds. translated_title: 通过弱差分隐私在线学习实现纳什激励相容的在线机制学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究一个多轮机制设计问题，其中我们在一系列轮次中与一组参与者（智能体）进行交互。我们希望设计一个激励相容（IC）的在线学习方案，在给定的一类机制中最大化特定应用的目标，而无需预先了解参与者的类型分布。即使该类中的每个机制在单轮中都是激励相容的，如果算法在每一轮中简单地从该类机制中进行选择，整个学习过程对于跨越多轮出现的非短视买家而言可能不再是激励相容的。在每一轮中，我们的方法在弱差分隐私在线学习算法（例如Hedge算法）的推荐与惩罚不真实行为的承诺机制之间进行随机选择。我们的方法是激励相容的，并在对抗性环境下针对特定应用目标实现了 $O(T^{\frac{1+h}{2}})$ 的遗憾度，其中 $h$ 量化了参与者的远见程度。
tldr: 本文提出一种在弱差分隐私在线学习算法的推荐与惩罚不真实行为的承诺机制之间随机选择的方法，解决了多轮在线机制设计中面对非短视参与者时保持全流程激励相容的难题，并在对抗环境下实现了次线性遗憾度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method that randomly chooses between a weakly differentially private online learning algorithm and a commitment mechanism penalizing untruthful behavior, maintaining incentive compatibility across multiple rounds against non-myopic agents while achieving sublinear regret in adversarial settings.
